name: CCZ gate (phase gadgets)
summary: The CCZ gate is a phase polynomial: π/4 phases on every qubit, −π/4 gadgets on every pair and a π/4 gadget on all three.
description: The CCZ gate is diagonal, $|x_1x_2x_3\rangle \mapsto (-1)^{x_1x_2x_3}|x_1x_2x_3\rangle$, and since $4x_1x_2x_3 = x_1+x_2+x_3 - (x_1\oplus x_2) - (x_2\oplus x_3) - (x_1\oplus x_3) + (x_1\oplus x_2\oplus x_3)$ it is a product of π/4 phases on single qubits and ∓π/4 phase gadgets on parities. This gives the well-known decomposition of the CCZ (and hence the Toffoli) gate with 7 T-gates. Drawn in graph-like form.
